books.name: Genesis
books.description: The first book of the Bible, covering creation, the fall, and God's covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

books.name: Exodus
books.description: The story of Israel's liberation from Egypt through Moses, the giving of the Law at Sinai, and the Tabernacle.

books.name: Leviticus
books.description: Laws and rituals given to Israel covering sacrifice, holiness, and the priesthood.

books.name: Numbers
books.description: Israel's wilderness journey, including the census of tribes and the forty years of wandering.

books.name: Deuteronomy
books.description: Moses' farewell addresses restating the Law and preparing Israel to enter the Promised Land.

books.name: Joshua
books.description: The conquest and division of Canaan under Israel's leader Joshua after Moses' death.

books.name: Judges
books.description: Cycles of sin, oppression, and deliverance in Israel through leaders called judges.

books.name: Ruth
books.description: A story of loyalty and redemption following a Moabite woman who follows her mother-in-law to Israel.

books.name: 1 Samuel
books.description: Israel's transition from judges to monarchy through the lives of Samuel, Saul, and David.

books.name: 2 Samuel
books.description: The reign of King David over Israel, his triumphs and his failures.

books.name: 1 Kings
books.description: Solomon's reign and the building of the Temple, followed by the division of Israel's kingdom.

books.name: 2 Kings
books.description: The decline and fall of both Israel and Judah, ending in exile under Assyria and Babylon.

books.name: 1 Chronicles
books.description: A retelling of Israel's history from Adam to David, focusing on the priesthood and worship.

books.name: 2 Chronicles
books.description: The history of Judah's kings from Solomon through the exile and the decree of Cyrus.

books.name: Ezra
books.description: The return of Jewish exiles from Babylon and the restoration of worship in Jerusalem.

books.name: Nehemiah
books.description: Nehemiah leads the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls and the renewal of the covenant community.

books.name: Esther
books.description: A Jewish woman becomes queen of Persia and saves her people from genocide.

books.name: Job
books.description: The story of a righteous man who suffers greatly, raising profound questions about suffering and God's justice.

books.name: Psalms
books.description: 150 songs and prayers covering praise, lament, thanksgiving, and wisdom — the hymnbook of Israel.

books.name: Proverbs
books.description: Practical wisdom for daily life, covering work, relationships, speech, and the fear of the Lord.

books.name: Ecclesiastes
books.description: A meditation on the meaning of life "under the sun," concluding that fearing God is all that matters.

books.name: Song of Solomon
books.description: A collection of love poetry celebrating the beauty of romantic love as a gift from God.

books.name: Isaiah
books.description: Prophecies of judgment and salvation, with a vision of the coming Servant of the Lord and new creation.

books.name: Jeremiah
books.description: The weeping prophet calls Judah to repentance before and during the Babylonian conquest of Jerusalem.

books.name: Lamentations
books.description: Poems of grief over the destruction of Jerusalem and the suffering of God's people in exile.

books.name: Ezekiel
books.description: Vivid prophetic visions given to Ezekiel in Babylon, pointing to Israel's restoration and God's glory.

books.name: Daniel
books.description: Stories of faithfulness and apocalyptic visions of world empires and God's ultimate kingdom.

books.name: Hosea
books.description: God's faithful love for unfaithful Israel, told through the prophet's own painful marriage.

books.name: Joel
books.description: A locust plague as a call to repentance, with a promise of the outpouring of God's Spirit.

books.name: Amos
books.description: A shepherd-prophet confronts Israel's social injustice and empty religious ritual.

books.name: Obadiah
books.description: A short oracle of judgment against Edom for betraying their brother nation Israel.

books.name: Jonah
books.description: A reluctant prophet flees from God, is swallowed by a great fish, and brings Nineveh to repentance.

books.name: Micah
books.description: Prophecies of judgment and restoration, with the famous promise of a ruler born in Bethlehem.

books.name: Nahum
books.description: An oracle pronouncing Nineveh's doom and the end of Assyrian oppression over Israel.

books.name: Habakkuk
books.description: A prophet wrestles with God over injustice and evil, concluding with a song of trust.

books.name: Zephaniah
books.description: The Day of the Lord is announced as both judgment and the hope of a purified remnant.

books.name: Haggai
books.description: A call to the returned exiles to rebuild the Temple and trust in God's greater glory to come.

books.name: Zechariah
books.description: Night visions and messianic prophecies pointing to a coming king who enters Jerusalem on a donkey.

books.name: Malachi
books.description: The last prophetic voice of the Old Testament, calling Israel to faithfulness before the Day of the Lord.

books.name: Matthew
books.description: The Gospel of Jesus as Israel's Messiah and the fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy.

books.name: Mark
books.description: The fastest-paced Gospel, presenting Jesus as the powerful Servant of God who came to give his life.

books.name: Luke
books.description: A detailed account of Jesus' life and ministry with special attention to the poor, women, and outcasts.

books.name: John
books.description: The theological Gospel, presenting Jesus as the eternal Word of God through signs and "I am" sayings.

books.name: Acts
books.description: The spread of the early church from Jerusalem to Rome through the power of the Holy Spirit.

books.name: Romans
books.description: Paul's comprehensive letter on justification by faith, the gospel, and life in the Spirit.

books.name: 1 Corinthians
books.description: Paul addresses divisions, immorality, spiritual gifts, and the resurrection in the church at Corinth.

books.name: 2 Corinthians
books.description: Paul defends his apostleship and calls the Corinthians to reconciliation and generosity.

books.name: Galatians
books.description: Paul's passionate defense of justification by faith alone against those adding the Law to the gospel.

books.name: Ephesians
books.description: God's eternal plan to unite all things in Christ, and the call to walk worthy of that calling.

books.name: Philippians
books.description: A letter of joy written from prison, calling believers to unity, humility, and contentment in Christ.

books.name: Colossians
books.description: Christ's supremacy over all creation and the call to set your mind on things above.

books.name: 1 Thessalonians
books.description: Encouragement to a young church and teaching on the second coming of Christ.

books.name: 2 Thessalonians
books.description: Correction of confusion about the Day of the Lord and a call to steadfast work and faith.

books.name: 1 Timothy
books.description: Paul's instructions to Timothy on church leadership, sound doctrine, and godly conduct.

books.name: 2 Timothy
books.description: Paul's final letter, urging Timothy to guard the gospel and endure hardship as a soldier of Christ.

books.name: Titus
books.description: Instructions for establishing godly church order and the transforming power of God's grace.

books.name: Philemon
books.description: A personal appeal from Paul asking Philemon to receive back his runaway slave Onesimus as a brother.

books.name: Hebrews
books.description: Christ as the superior high priest and the fulfillment of all Old Testament types and shadows.

books.name: James
books.description: Practical wisdom on faith that works, taming the tongue, and caring for the poor.

books.name: 1 Peter
books.description: Encouragement to suffering believers to stand firm in grace as God's holy and elect people.

books.name: 2 Peter
books.description: A call to grow in grace and guard against false teachers who distort the truth.

books.name: 1 John
books.description: Tests for genuine Christian fellowship: walking in light, loving one another, and believing in Christ.

books.name: 2 John
books.description: A brief letter urging a chosen lady and her children to walk in love and reject false teachers.

books.name: 3 John
books.description: A commendation of Gaius for his hospitality and a warning against the pride of Diotrephes.

books.name: Jude
books.description: A call to contend earnestly for the faith against ungodly teachers who have crept into the church.

books.name: Revelation
books.description: Apocalyptic visions of the cosmic conflict between good and evil, ending in the new heaven and earth.
